In phase I, logging capabilities were added to Scala so that information is captured about the execution. these logs were used to produce useful information for the user to figure out what could have gone wrong.

name: ouyanguf/gossip-simulator
description: Gossip type algorithms can be used both for group communication and for aggregate computation. The goal of this project is to determine the convergence of such algorithms through a simulator based on actors written in Scala. Since actors in Scala are fully asynchronous, the particular type of Gossip implemented is the so called Asynchronous Gossip.

name: ouyanguf/find-perfect-square
description: Input:  The input provided (as command line to your project1.scala) will be two numbers: N and k. The overall goal of your program is to find all k consecutive numbers, starting at 1, such that the sum of squares is itself a perfect square (square of an integer).  Output:  Print, on independent lines, the first number in the sequence for each solution.
